decisions.reason: The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws directly on the firm's material and craftsmanship knowledge, so it can absorb feedback and refine the product within its premium range.
This decorative carpet builds closely on the existing textile range and designer collaborations, though the earlier pruning of a similar low-pile carpet signals continued rationalization risk.
The corner bench extends core furniture and customization competence, letting the firm interpret project feedback and adapt it for residential and hospitality use.
The low-pile carpet fits the textile offer, but it overlaps with similar launches and Product A has already been withdrawn, so it remains a moderate candidate for further pruning.
The multi-model swivel shell chair line rests on deep seating know-how across workplace and residential markets, giving strong capacity to learn from results and improve the models.
